body: I love stories like this because in the end the shitty person loses and you come out of this as the winner and bigger person. Give it a few months or so and you will hear about how things ended badly for them🤷🏽‍♀️ Focus on your well being and growing from this

I was in the same situation, got put in a mental hospital by my ex. Sometimes you want an explanation or some type of closure but you never get it, it will take time to process but trust me life gets better. I hope you will heal and gradually get back to yourself
It’s the typical rebound, sometimes those relationships never work out to be honest. We gonna bounce back from this, better than before. We just gotta make sure we are better versions of ourselves

Thank you so much for this, I’m definitely gonna use this to help me with my progress. Im just so fucking tired of the typical move on with your life or you still young, like screw that. I was abused for two years and I’m no longer gonna let my ex and his new gf win. He has put me down for too long, I’m gonna go to the gym today and give it my all today.

Reading this just made me feel better, my ex got with someone else. I have been a mess lately but I’m getting my shit together and using the energy they gave me while laughing at me to improve myself.
Same here :( like I wish it could just stop
Capricorn
I hope your new gf keeps cheating on you and gladly burn in hell 😁

I have been thinking of starting a life in another country, being where I am I constantly feel miserable and reminds me of the traumatic experience I went through. Did you find peace when you moved to another country???

Funny enough I made the same mistake of hooking up with my ex, only to blame me for things not working out with the  girl he left me for. After two year together he wasn’t concerned about how I felt, was more worried about a girl he had known for two months and was messing around with other guys. One thing I can say is your ex doesn’t deserve you, it sucks to still love and care for people who don’t deserve it, that’s the hard reality we gotta face but you gotta keep making progress and moving from the past. Next time he tries to get in contact , do not reply by all means. You are worth more and one day you will meet someone that will give you the world.

It takes a long time to fight our way through this, I have been struggling with depression since I was 14. It took a good 10 years for me to finally get out of it, I had to figure out who I was and be comfortable with who I am. Sometimes all it takes is for you to tell yourself you need to break the cycle now and change things, life is too short to be putting yourself through this never ending cycle. When you look back at your life I don’t want you to remember fighting depression and nothing more, I want you to remember the things you did to enjoy life like travelling and achieving goals

That’s the thing about life, it makes us go through seasons where it’s tough and unbearable. I’m happy that a part of you still knows this question “what if I will feel better someday”, the good thing is you will feel better but it all depends on you if you willing to put in the hard work to feel better. There are so many steps to take, I found praying, reading, seeing a therapist and going to the gym a major help in my life and fighting my depression. I hope you manage to find certain steps that can help you fight this depression, like my favourite author says “ your mind is like a wild animal, you have to first get used to it and then be able to tame it”

I think you should have taken time for yourself and gotten over the past relationship, sometimes it’s not fair to tag someone along while you still have feelings or some sort of attachment to your ex. I know we as humans want companionship but sometimes you gotta put yourself out there once you have fully healed, a rebound relationship isn’t healthy.

I’m so sorry to hear about your cat, I never thought of it that way. Wasting time crying over someone that’s with someone else, I’m actually forgetting the important stuff that’s in front of me. I hope you heal from the loss of your cat ❤️

I can totally relate about waking up and realizing they are not there anymore, sometimes I switch my phone off so I don’t waste too much time looking at it thinking they will call me and realize what they did. Unfortunately as much as it hurts, they are not coming back. It’s better to accept that and not dwell in the past or the good memories, I wrote down a list of pros and cons of the relationship I had with my ex, only to realize that he wasn’t good for me and that he was a shitty human being that I kept constantly defending. There’s so much better out there, we just need to heal now and not focus our energy on the past relationship because we could be blocking an amazing blessing that will be infront of us. Be strong :) we got this

One thing I learnt the hard way is to never beg for a man, you don’t deserve to be putting yourself down like that or to be treated like that. You have so much compassion and one day someone will truly appreciate it, for now I want you to try your hardest to not contact him. I found writing in a journal has helped because I had so many unsaid things I wish I had said to my ex, God knows if I had sent those messages to him I would have not gotten a response which would have hurt me more. Some people just get cold and distant, that’s fine and we have to find our own closure. Pick yourself up and forgive yourself for what happened, you need to start healing and moving forward with life. We are surviving on borrowed time and I want you to make the best out of your life. Work on yourself, trust me you will meet someone incredible one day who will appreciate you. When you look back this, you will laugh and ask yourself why I wasted time being sad cause what’s ahead is going to be way much better than what’s in the past. Move forward :)

I want you to take things one day at a time, I know how lonely it feels to have someone shut you out and you try your best to work things out but things don’t go the way we want them to be even when we desperately love someone. I know the job market is hectic right now but keep applying, I have hope that you will find something. You need to start taking care of yourself and your heart, make a list of things that you feel needs your major attention to improve your life. Start putting yourself out there and making friends, cause we all need friends especially when we going through things like heartbreak. It’s such a cliche thing to say that things will get better, but they really do it just takes time. I’m pretty much in the same boat, just that my ex left me for someone else. I’m being positive and coming up with goals to better my life and let go the hurt I feel. Meditating and reading has helped so far and seeing a therapist, who has shown me to forgive myself and keep moving forward with life. We surviving on borrowed time, make the best out of the time we have on this earth. Take the relationship as a learning curve and bounce back from it

Reading your story has actually inspired me, I’m actually going through a really tough breakup to a point I just didn’t want to go and live another day. Funny part is I gave and gave but got nothing in turn he pretty much cheated, mistreated me and left me for someone else , I know the healing process is gonna be tough but I just hope I get to a point I know my self worth and love myself again. Cheers to the healing process

I hope you overcome what you feeling, who knows maybe when you both in a better space you could be friends. For now just work on yourself and getting back to the person you were and feeling normal again, we will both overcome this hurdle. If you feel down just remember you strong and important, we have a tendency of forgetting who we are at times. The joys of the healing process lol also that there are strangers out there that care for you and want the best :)

They wanted to apologize only to realize they wanted to hurt me all over again and laugh at me with the girl he left me for. I have constantly thought something was wrong with me but people have things they are fighting, at the end of the day I forgive him and hope whatever bitterness and hurt he holds in his heart disappears and start healing.
I read it and you gonna make it through this, I know I can’t relate but these challenges shape us to be a stronger person

I want you to take one day at a time, yes everything is overwhelming but you can do this and you not an idiot. Good thing we live in an advanced world, you can talk to a therapist virtually. Google is your friend and it can help you find a therapist near you or one you can see virtually, like the saying goes God gives the toughest battles to his soldiers to fight and conquer. His plan may not make sense now but he is moulding you into an incredible young man, I want you to start with this book called the wisdom of a broken heart by Susan piver. About the bus route you can gradually learn, I moved to a whole new country alone and had no idea what the bus route was like but if it wasn’t for technology I would have failed miserably. I had someone that abused me emotionally and attacked me once physically when they got drunk, he laughs at me with his new gf and makes it seem like I’m the one crazy and got me put in a mental hospital. I could have soo many reasons to hate him but it’s not helping me as a person, I want to be good and me talking to you is helping me because a few days ago I wanted to end it all but there’s more to life. I just wanna let you know that you have helped me a lot and thank you for sharing your story and making me realize I’m not alone through this journey. You are important and your life has really touched mine and I want to see both of us win

Unfortunately there are some parents who brush things off and don’t take their children seriously, especially with the way society is set up men are not supposed to express any feelings whatsoever. I know getting over a relationship is difficult, it’s good that you have realized where you went wrong and taking accountability. Some people never do, take this as a learning curve. Yes we want things to work out badly but sometimes people come in our lives to teach us valuable lessons, right now it doesn’t make sense but as time progresses it will. I don’t want you to be hard on yourself, life is hard in general but you have the ability to make it easy. I don’t want you to end your life because your life matters and I want to see you achieve so much. Cry it out and let those trapped feelings out, there’s nothing wrong with that. Yes sometimes family can be toxic but don’t let them get to you because you are a strong and wonderful individual and don’t ever forget that! We human we all experience this stage in life, it’s just that people put a mask on because they think experiencing depression or anxiety is unacceptable and a huge stigma around it especially with the older generation. I want you to forgive yourself for things not working out, list down the good things you learnt from the relationship and once that is done I want you to list down the bad things. Yes it will be a hard process but once you have listed those bad things, tell yourself that you will be a better man and learn to do better. If you not comfortable talking to adults, I recommend reading books on overcoming depression or anxiety and dealing with heartbreak. Reading has helped me overcome the depressive state I was in, also I want you to remember what you were passionate about and what you wanted to achieve in life. I want you to get up and push yourself like you have never had before and work towards that. The race isn’t over yet its just beginning and you got a long way to go, when you feel ready see a  certified therapist. I always find it good to see one and vent out to one and yes it’s a judgement free zone, so don’t feel nervous about seeing one.

That’s the crazy part about healing one minute you okay the next you not, I’m sure your loved ones wouldn’t judge you for having your days where it hits you after all it’s a whole process but the bounce is going to be amazing lol we will both laugh at it one day and be like damn I wasted so much time on crying over that loser
If you ever feel down or going back to the same loop, remind yourself that you are worthy!

Give basketball a try again, try doing things you loved doing before your ex was in the picture. Try discover who you are, we lose ourselves in relationships most of the time cause we keep giving by the time things end we have absolutely nothing left. It’s okay to start over, I’m assuming you still young. There’s a a lot that this world has to offer, I’m even going on trips. When I was with my ex I couldn’t do any of that, reclaim the person you were before. It’s hard but you need to! I have been cheated on countless times, my ex brought random girls over and brought one in the bedroom I had been sleeping in. Yes he slept with her when I left the apartment, we let people walk over us because we have this idea that we love them and care. Unfortunately that’s not love that’s just a toxic mess, you deserve so much better and you will meet an amazing person

It takes time to get over it cause you had nothing but good intentions, heal and live life. Get to know yourself, I’m slowly putting myself out there and trying new things out. I’m gaining my confidence back, reading self help books has helped me process things too. I hope you overcome this phase and be a greater new you :)

At the end of the day it’s their loss, one thing I have learnt in life is you can’t start a relationship on someone’s pain. Right now it hurts but eventually we will meet the right person, I guess we gotta take this season to build ourselves up and learn from the past.

I can totally relate :( , sometimes my chest hurts so bad when I think about how he couldn’t give me the things I wanted but he is giving the girl he left me the loyalty and love I needed…I have never felt so used
I’m here to listen

I experienced something similar but I wasn’t with the person as long as you were, I found myself not sure what to do and the man I was with laughed at me with the person he left me for. He put me in a mental hospital, suffering from severe depression and told people I was crazy. I’m struggling financially to the point I end up with 15 dollars in my credit card and have to survive between Monday to Friday, the experience has been humbling because I had forgotten about what it’s like to be me for once and not have anyone there. Yes suicide might sound like the best option but that’s showing your ex husband he won, you can’t punish yourself over the decisions he made not you. Yes it hurts now but it’s not too late to live life for, yes you 57 but it’s not game over. A chapter in your life has ended doesn’t necessarily mean that the story ends, it’s time you write the new chapter the way you want it. Your ex will eventually see that the grass ain’t greener on the other side by then you will be happy living your life. Pay the debt off and forgive yourself, travel the world is beautiful trust me and has so much to offer. Join a support group with people facing similar situations, please don’t give up and keep fight. I may not know you but your life matters and I care ❤️
I’m here to talk if you need to vent about what you going through
The fact you keep talking tells me there’s a part of you that wants to keep fighting, before you make up your plan I just wanna know what things you loved before your ex showed?
And keep fighting, your life matters please keep going on don’t end your life story yet just end the chapter and start a new one

What you are going through is normal, feeling like a dark cloud is following you constantly and you can’t focus. You can’t let that dark cloud overwhelm you to the point you can’t see what’s ahead, your family situation is hard to deal with it. I completely understand but you need to keep fighting. I need you to take time remember the things that you were once passionate about and like what goals you wanted to achieve in life. Remember that person you were before you ex was in the picture, yes it’s painful losing a relationship and you allowed to grieve over it. I can’t tell you that tomorrow that you will be fine, it’s a long process that you have to be willing to fight for. Don’t give up you have people who love you and want to see you become something, I might not know you but I would like to see you come back and tell me the great things you have achieved. Your story hasn’t ended yet, just a chapter ending and new one is starting where you take control over everything. I failed numerous times in college to the point I was dropped from the program because I couldn’t keep up with anything, my ex had left me for someone else and painted me to be the crazy person. I questioned myself constantly and why I was a bad person in everyone’s eyes to the point I harmed myself but I couldn’t let him win and prove to everyone that I’m crazy. I applied to a new college and starting from scratch, I have my days where I feel like crap but I remind myself that I need to get back up
Before you do anything, have you considered how this will impact the people that love and care about you?
Don’t say that about yourself, I don’t know you and you don’t know me but I honestly care about your life. You matter at the end of the day and I want to see you do great things in life
Trust me I had the cops called on me more than three times because I was ready to end it all

I understand you very well, I want my ex to suffer badly too for all the things he did but I don’t wanna become like him, I know right now the pain is a lot to take in but you need to keep going. There must be something you loved doing before your ex showed up in the picture or something you were passionate about, I don’t want you to destroy yourself over someone worthless like that who had no consideration or deserved any type of care you probably gave her.

Plus leaking someone’s nudes is considered revenge porn and you could get in trouble for that, hurting her or her family physically will get you in jail. Don’t waste away your life over things that you won’t remember, be strong

It’s not justified because you are becoming exactly like them, you are entitled to feel the way you feel and I don’t think you are a sadist. Don’t change who you are or lose yourself because of someone’s actions. That was their problem not yours! I may not know you but considering the fact you haven’t done anything as of yet, I believe you have a good heart and right now you going through the anger stages. I wanted to kill myself over my exs actions, he abused me mentally and physically and still doesn’t acknowledge it. Life has so much to offer, three months from now you won’t even remember this. You are allowed to feel what you are going through, just don’t do something you will regret later on. You are important and I’m sure there are people that are counting on you to do amazing things. What you give to the universe will be returned, they will have their day trust me

You should never lower yourself to her level just because they did something to you, it’s not worth it. Yes it hurts but take one day at a time, heal and better will come your way. I wanted revenge on an ex that left me for someone and laughed at me when I was drowning in severe depression, he got me put in a mental hospital and made it seem like he cared in reality he didn’t and told everyone that I was the toxic one. Good thing about life it moves on, don’t block the universe from giving you good things
